sk_toss_and_catch: tosses three wooden masks into the air and catches them one after another, a grinning crowd behind.
sk_ace_up_sleeve: pulls a painted playing card from his sleeve with a flourish, the other hand held up innocently.
sk_jest_patter: leans forward talking fast with wild gestures at a confused hunched creature that clutches its head.
sk_quick_hands: @close-up of a jester's quick long-fingered hands making a small wooden ball vanish between three cups on a barrel.
sk_reshuffle: shuffles a fan of painted cards so fast they blur, standing on an upturned barrel.
sk_bear_romp: wearing a carved bear mask, stomps and rolls in a wild dance that knocks a creature off its feet.
sk_laugh_and_fear: laughs with his head thrown back while hunched shadowy creatures cower and back away from him.
sk_mara_grin: wearing a pale skull-like mask of Mara, grins at a frozen creature, frost on his coat.
sk_last_bow: takes a deep bow on a village stage as the curtain behind him falls and scattered creatures lie stunned.
sk_trick_box: @close-up of an open painted wooden trick box full of masks, bells, cards and a coiled toy snake.
